nodes.label: ESG, Sustainability & Climate Disclosure
nodes.summary: Environmental, social, and governance reporting requirements including ESG Guide, board oversight, climate disclosures, and scope 1/2/3 emissions reporting.

nodes.label: ESG Guide Requirements
nodes.summary: Listed companies must report on ESG matters in accordance with the ESG Guide. The guide covers environmental, social, and governance aspects with mandatory and recommended disclosures.

nodes.label: MBL ESG Guide — Environmental, Social and Governance Reporting
nodes.summary: Sets out ESG reporting requirements including environmental emissions, social practices, and governance structure. Mandatory and recommended disclosures.

nodes.label: Board Oversight of ESG
nodes.summary: The board must oversee ESG matters and ensure the company has appropriate ESG governance structures and reporting processes.

nodes.label: Climate Disclosures
nodes.summary: Listed companies must disclose climate-related risks and opportunities in line with the Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures (TCFD) recommendations.

nodes.label: Scope 1/2/3 Emissions Reporting
nodes.summary: Listed companies must report Scope 1 and Scope 2 greenhouse gas emissions. Scope 3 emissions reporting is recommended where material.
